description: This Python source file implements an audio filter class 'AICFilter' that uses the ai-coustics AIC SDK to enhance audio streams in real time. It integrates with Pipecat's audio filtering pipeline and manages initialization, configuration, processing, and cleanup of the AIC SDK model. It also provides methods for creating VAD analyzers and handling control frames for enabling/disabling filtering.

classes.name: AICFilter
classes.description: An audio filter that integrates the ai-coustics AIC SDK for real-time audio enhancement.
